body: The token-login usage probe (one /v1/messages call, max_tokens 1, reading anthropic-ratelimit-unified-* headers) spends plan quota, so it runs only when explicitly asked: `agx usage --logins`, `agx usage --login NAME`, `--login auto`, `login check` (skip with --no-probe). A plain `agx` / `agx usage` never probes (LOGINS_SPEC D14, 2026-10-16). Code: provider/claude/probe.go.
